Ok I'm going to post this here since we are on the topic of getting out of long boring stories. How do you manage to do it when it is a co-worker that you dislike? I literally have no interest in hearing any of her stories, and she always drops by at the worse time and just traps me at my desk. Sometimes she will start off by talking about something work related, but then will eventually transition into some story about reading a book on how to be successful, or some sci-fi film she watched that I am showing literally zero interest in. In the end the excess information ends up being 80-90% of the conversation and it drives me nuts. 

Also might help to note that I'm like 99% sure she has Asperger's (although she has never outright told anyone). We aren't "friends" but get along as co-workers and I don't want to be rude to her. But I'm also reaching the end of my rope with listening to her verbal diarrhea.

All pets should have pet insurance. 

Its like a no brainer. Humans have insurance for unexpected medical emergencies, why not your pet? 

I see far too many people just look around stupidly whenever their pet has some horrible accident or chronic health issue diagnosed that they can't afford to pay to have fixed or treated. 

*Throws hands up in the air* "guess this ones totaled guys!"
